title: Educational HF layer and noise scenario comparison
hypothesis: A simplified flat-layer secant cutoff varies with declared virtual height and path geometry; declared in-band noise changes reference SNR without changing the cutoff.
differentiation: No novel HF method is established. This fixture uses established simplified relationships; literature/program review and real channel validation remain required.

scenarios.label: Fictional reference virtual layer
scenarios.assumption_reference: Illustrative virtual layer and total noise in declared bandwidth; not ionosonde or environmental data

scenarios.label: Fictional 10 dB higher in-band noise
scenarios.assumption_reference: Sensitivity fixture; noise changes only, not a time/weather forecast

scenarios.label: Fictional higher virtual layer
scenarios.assumption_reference: Geometry sensitivity fixture; no real ionospheric profile

sounding.assumption_reference: Assumed vertical round-trip group delays; virtual height convention, not true-height inversion or detected echoes
